title: Herod's Disturbance and the Magi's Search
english: When Herod heard this, he was greatly troubled, and calling the priests, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born. They answered and did not deny; they confessed and did not lie. They were unable to hide the rays of the sun, and they testified to the voice concerning the Savior being made clear through the prophet, saying: 'In Bethlehem the Christ is born.' For thus it cries through the prophet: 'And you, Bethlehem, are by no means the least among the rulers of Judah; for from you shall come forth one to be a ruler in Israel.'

O, the unyielding Israel! They confessed what was written in the Law, yet they denied the Lawgiver. They themselves testified where the Christ was to be born, and yet they themselves again denied the Christ who was born. What, then, of the Magi? Their minds were unsettled, their hearts were greatly troubled and consumed by grief, their sobs like the violence of waves flooded their ship, their eyes poured out pearl-like tears upon the earth, and their distress was boundless as they sought the Rising Sun, a guide they did not possess, yet they searched while having [the desire]. Where is the star, the guide of the Magi? Just as the star is hidden from them, look to the truth, and...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in laudes Mariae deiparae u02-rem-early

title: The Star and the Gifts of the Magi
english: Look at the wonder and the sign! Because of this, the star was hidden from them, so that when the unbelieving priests asked about it, the mystery of heaven and earth might be made manifest to all. Therefore, after everyone had come to know, the star was revealed again to the Magi, until it came and stood over the Child in the cave, or rather, in heaven. For where Christ is, there is heaven; for the cave appeared as heaven upon the earth.

Those who saw the star, and even more so the Savior, rejoiced with great joy; they bowed down and worshiped, and brought out their gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Gold, as for a king; frankincense, as for God; and myrrh, as for a mortal—but rather so that they might also signify the burial of Christ, the Creator and Maker of all, whom the heavenly bride Mary brought forth, she who is the heaven, the temple, and the throne of the Divinity, the ineffable treasure of Paradise.

Angels once praised Eve, but now they glorify Mary; she who, having glorified the weakest of women, raised up the fallen Eve, and sent Adam, who was cast out of Paradise, into the heavens, and she who opened the closed Paradise, and through the thief again...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in laudes Mariae deiparae u02-rem-mid

title: The Fruits of Mary's Obedience
english: You have planted Adam again. For through you, O holy Virgin, the enmity that stood in the middle of the barrier was destroyed; through you, heavenly peace was granted to the world; through you, the ends of the inhabited earth were enlightened; through you, humans have become like angels; through you, humans have been called friends, servants, and children of God; and through you, humans have been worthy to become fellow-servants and fellow-neighbors of the angels. Through you, heavenly knowledge is sent up from earth to the heavens in praise; through you, humans have boldness before the Most High in heaven. Through you, the Cross has shone throughout the whole inhabited world, upon which your Child, Christ our God, was hung. Through you, death is trampled and Hades is plundered; through you, idols have fallen and heavenly knowledge has been awakened. Through you, we have come to know the only-begotten Son of God whom you bore, O all-holy Virgin, our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom all angels and humans, while worshiping, say that we glorify the unoriginated Father, the unoriginated Son, and the unoriginated Holy Spirit, the indivisible and consubstantial Trinity, unto the ages of ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in laudes Mariae deiparae u02-rem-close
